newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel weaker as benchmark IPE gas oil dips.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel weaker as benchmark IPE gas oil dips.

text.p: NWE jet fuel prices were around $3-4 tonne weaker on Friday, tracking sharp losses on benchmark IPE gas oil futures in thin trade.
However, traders said that despite the weakness on gas oil, jet cargo premiums were pegged steady around Feb IPE +$26/+$27 a tonne.
They said trade in NWE was slow, but possible arbitrage opportunities to the Far East were the focus of a stable Mediterranean market.
However, traders said the high cost of shipping and the difficulty in securing suitable tonnage limited arbitrage trading options.
